purpose: Predeclared stronger event-model comparison on an already inspected local corpus
evaluation: 5 outer stratified video-hash-group folds, 4 inner folds, seed 17

stronger_model.encoder: frozen torchvision R3D-18 Kinetics-400 pretrained action features
stronger_model.features: unit-normalized action features plus within-video mean-centered action features
stronger_model.positive_training_windows: centers within 2 seconds of a weak anchor; nearest-center window fallback per anchor
stronger_model.negative_training_windows: all windows of explicit negative videos only
stronger_model.training_weights: equal total weight per video, balanced binary class weight
stronger_model.threshold_selection: inner video OOF: maximize balanced accuracy, then minimum class recall, then nearest 0.5, then higher threshold

baseline.encoder: existing frozen DINOv2 whole-video mean/std/last-first features

nested_rules: Fit every transform and head exclusively inside its training fold
Choose regularization and threshold only using inner OOF predictions
Outer test windows are uniform and never selected with known timestamps
Aggregate outer predictions using each fold's own frozen threshold
After recording comparison metrics, select full-corpus training settings and fit the final research artifact
Do not present the final all-data fit or its selection scores as independent test accuracy
limits: Exact byte hashes do not establish independence of cameras, sessions or near-duplicate clips
Previously inspected data and model iteration make this exploratory, not external validation
Weak timestamps do not provide reviewed event boundaries
No supervised category or bounding-box performance is claimed
